content:
Pancho walks 20 miles per day on weekdays and 10 miles per day on weekends. A standard week has 5 weekdays (Monday through Friday) and 2 weekend days (Saturday and Sunday).

Miles on weekdays: 5 days × 20 miles/day = 100 miles  
Miles on weekends: 2 days × 10 miles/day = 20 miles  
Total miles in a week: 100 + 20 = 120 miles

Answer: 120
